threads.body: This pins `fsspec` to an exact version while docs use a minimum version constraint. If the intent is to keep all environments aligned, consider using a shared constraints file (`-c`) so that docs/tests (and any other environments) resolve `fsspec` consistently without needing to update multiple files per bump.

The `fsspec` version constraint is duplicated across multiple requirements files (docs and util/opentelemetry-util-genai tests). This increases the chance of drift over time. Consider centralizing `fsspec` constraints in a shared constraints file (e.g., `constraints.txt`) and referencing it via `-c`, or factoring shared dependencies into a common requirements file referenced via `-r`.
